page.overview:
Who is Jesús Iglesias?

Jesús Iglesias (born 22 February 1922 and died 11 July 2005) was an Argentine racing driver who participated in the 1955 Argentine Grand Prix. He only completed 38 of the 96 laps in the race due to a transmission failure. He was the highest ranking driver in the race.

Much of his racing success came racing a Chevrolet Special in Argentina endurance racing. After being invited to race for the works Gordini team at his home Grand Prix in , he also participated at the non-championship race a couple of weeks later at the same circuit, finishing 16th.

After his brief Formula One career, he returned to endurance racing, largely participating only in races within Argentina.
